environment.platform: Unprivileged Linux x86_64 host; disposable Ubuntu 18 containers with SYS_ADMIN for private mounts

regressionReproduction.cleanStartup: Both exit 125 before backend socket creation: 384 MiB mount rejected by stale 128 MiB capacity guard
regressionReproduction.nativeOnlyDifferential: Published 0.13.2 JavaScript plus only the corrected native launcher passed all four startup cases
regressionReproduction.fix: One WORK_MIB constant supplies both mount size and capacity ceiling; isolation flags retained

packagedStartup.evidence: Actual Node 8 root launcher, private resolver/mount namespace, 384 MiB noexec/nosuid/nodev tmpfs, UID 3911 and app/audio groups, socket ownership/mode, rejected wrong peer UID, authenticated ready/audioStatus, fd3 readiness, root-owned 0644 status, preserved symlink victim and legacy markers, sandboxed Chromium and actual 1280x384 projected RGBA frames; installed check.sh succeeded in every case
packagedStartup.activationBootProofLimit: Local rootless Docker exposes host /proc files as unmapped UID 65534, so only this additional root/proc ownership proof is explicitly unavailable locally. No production trust check was weakened. The same fixture runs against rootful Docker in the publication workflow.
packagedStartup.limits: No real systemd, firmware AudioManager/SmartX or physical headunit is exercised; the engine is actual, not a stub
packagedStartup.appArmorFixture: On a local Docker host advertising AppArmor, only the disposable test container uses apparmor=unconfined so SYS_ADMIN can create its private mounts. The fixture keeps read-only host inputs, isolated namespaces and no --privileged; application sandbox and production units are unchanged.

serviceActivation.officialPolicy: Unchanged official Store applyRestarts on the actual built runtime manifest leaves an already failed ordinary update stopped
serviceActivation.recovery: Packaged activation starts failed/inactive units after both names are proven boot-loaded; first-install gate returns reboot-pending and performs no hot start; activating unit uses bounded idempotent start
serviceActivation.ownershipModel: This Store policy integration uses authored systemctl/ownership fixtures; core tests also cover unsafe files/directories, hardlinks, symlinks, current-boot snapshot authority and recovery failure

runtimeReadiness.evidence: Protected fresh running status must match installed build version and app UID, reference a live supervisor, and match actual backend socket UID/GID/mode; status running is emitted only after backend listen callback sends exact fd3 sentinel
coreRegressionCases: starting to ready without real sleeps

node8.actualRuntime: Full packaged startup and real Chromium rendering passed in all four container cases

frontend.evidence: Localized QR camera instructions, actual projected QR image, renew/stop controls and existing browser controls; test-only English/German assertion fixed without production UI edits

store.sourceByteEquality: All distributed JavaScript, frontend UI, runtime helpers, installed check.sh and both service unit files match final source
store.nativeProvenance: New static backend-launch and system-loader audio-bridge source/binary hashes and ABI validated; explicit libdl dependency; unchanged base payloads verified

localArtifactEvidence.meaning: These exact local archives passed the local tests. CI compiles the locked source again and tests its own exact helpers before publishing generated hashes; native bytes may differ across trusted compilers.
